title: Threat Prioritization Scoring Policy
description: Composite scoring methodology for prioritizing vulnerable inventory items based on CVSS severity, exploit probability (EPSS), and active exploitation status (CISA KEV).

fields.cvss_score: Validated CVSS v3.1 base score for the highest-severity matching CVE. Must be derived from the CVSS vector string, not from potentially corrupted stored scores.
fields.epss_score: Maximum EPSS probability across all matched CVEs for the inventory item.
fields.kev_multiplier: 2.0 if any matched CVE appears in the CISA KEV catalog, 1.0 otherwise.

risk_score.formula: Sum of cvss_score values across all vulnerable inventory items
risk_score.description: Aggregate risk metric representing total validated CVSS exposure across the inventory.

sorting: Threat priority entries must be sorted by priority_score in descending order.
